exposure: estimated fetal weight large for gestational age (eLGA)
cohort: 440 women with a single prior CD and estimated fetal weight large for gestational age (eLGA) or neonatal weight > 90th percentile with singleton pregnancy and gestational age ≥ 37 weeks
finding: There was no significant difference in maternal-fetal morbidity between women with a prior CD and eLGA who underwent TOLAC compared to those who had an elective CD.
mod_finding: Trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) for estimated large-for-gestational-age fetuses is considered appropriate due to comparable maternal-fetal morbidity rates and an acceptable cesarean delivery rate.
